Name: Radioactive Frog Egg Trinket
Author: pheauxm
Description: Adds a "radioactive" variant to the Frog Egg trinket with its own color palette and glow (but same function). It's about as rare as prismatic and void frogs, but doesn't lower the chance of any color other than green frogs.

Downloads.Description: (1.0.1 fixes not being able to use frog eggs on the anvil)
